items.how: Turnover and cash-transaction working. (Retired: applicability is now worked out automatically from the client's figures.)
items.text: Tax audit applicability confirmed: business turnover above Rs 1 crore (Rs 10 crore where cash transactions are within 5%), professional receipts above Rs 50 lakh, or presumptive opt-out cases.

items.how: Note on form and section mapping used. (Retired: the report form is now chosen automatically from the entity and year.)
steps: Choose the report form for the year
items.text: Correct report format chosen: Form 3CA/3CB with 3CD for FY 2025-26; for tax year 2026-27 onwards, the audit report under s.63 of the IT Act 2025 (confirm final notified form).

steps: Check the partner's tax audit count in the firm register
items.text: Tax audits signed by the partner within the ICAI limit (60 per partner; presumptive-taxation audits excluded).

steps: List books of account maintained and where kept
Fill the list of books examined
items.text: Prescribed books of account maintained; place where kept; books examined listed.
Method of accounting and ICDS compliance verified; effect of ICDS adjustments on profit quantified.

steps: Check inclusion of taxes as per s.145A
items.text: Method of stock valuation and inclusion of taxes in valuation verified.

steps: List land and building sold in the year
Compare consideration with stamp duty value
items.text: Land or building transferred below stamp duty value reported.

steps: Verify additions, put-to-use dates and sales
items.text: Depreciation computed block-wise under the IT Act; additions and put-to-use dates verified.

steps: List employees' PF and ESI deducted month-wise
Compare deposit dates with due dates
Compute the disallowance for late deposits
items.text: Employees' PF and ESI contributions deposited by the statutory due dates (no grace period).

steps: Scan expenses for capital, personal, penalty and political-party items
items.text: Capital, personal, penalty and political-party expenses identified and reported.

steps: List payments liable to TDS where TDS was not deducted or not paid
items.text: Disallowance for non-deduction or non-payment of TDS computed.

steps: Check partners' interest and remuneration with the deed
items.text: Interest and remuneration to partners within limits and as per deed (firms only).

items.how: Cash book scan by party and date.
steps: Run a cash-book scan by party and date for payments above Rs 10,000 (Rs 35,000 for transporters)
items.text: Cash payments above Rs 10,000 per person per day (Rs 35,000 for goods carriages) identified.
Payments to specified persons listed and reasonableness considered.

steps: List statutory dues outstanding at year end
Check payment dates against the return due date
items.text: Statutory dues (GST, TDS, PF, ESI, bonus, leave encashment, interest to banks) paid before the due date of return; unpaid amounts disallowed.

steps: List old creditors written back and remissions
Check credit to profit and loss
items.text: Remission or cessation of liabilities and recoveries credited or reported.

steps: List shares issued at a premium and receipts below fair value
items.text: Receipts covered by s.56 identified and reported.

steps: Scan loan ledgers for amounts taken or repaid in cash
items.text: Loans or deposits of Rs 20,000 or more taken or repaid otherwise than by banking channels reported.

steps: Scan receipts for Rs 2 lakh or more in cash from one person
Check by day, transaction and event
items.text: Receipts of Rs 2 lakh or more in cash from one person in a day, transaction or event reported.

steps: Obtain assessment orders for brought-forward losses
items.text: Brought-forward losses and unabsorbed depreciation verified; change in shareholding checked.
Deductions claimed under Chapter VI-A verified with supporting documents.

steps: List short deduction, late payment and late filing
items.text: TDS / TCS deducted, deposited and returns filed on time; interest under s.201(1A) / 206C(7) computed.

steps: Prepare quantitative details of principal items
Reconcile opening, purchases, sales and closing
items.text: Quantitative details of principal items of goods traded or manufactured reconciled.

steps: Identify loans from closely held companies where the client is a shareholder
items.text: Loans or advances received from closely held companies with accumulated profits identified.

steps: Compute GP, NP and stock-turnover ratios
items.text: Turnover, gross profit, net profit and stock-turnover ratios compared with previous year.

steps: Download demands and refunds from tax and GST portals
items.text: Demands raised or refunds issued under tax laws during the year listed.
Forms 61, 61A and 61B filed where applicable.

steps: Analyse purchases by GST status of supplier
items.text: Expenditure split between GST-registered, composition, exempt and unregistered suppliers.

steps: Check interest paid to non-resident AEs
items.text: Interest to non-resident associated enterprises above Rs 1 crore tested for 30% of EBITDA limit.

items.how: Software and server confirmation from client.
items.ref: IT Act 2025 s.63 audit report (draft Form 26)
steps: Obtain details of software used for books and its server location
Obtain the backup server location in India
Record for the new audit report
items.text: Details of cloud or other software storing books, server location and backup server in India collected (tax year 2026-27 onwards).
